title: 第一卷 第16章 忍不了了
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华的手还在张春妮的腰上，没有松开，说道：“你再推，我就要掉到海里去了。”

    张春妮听到他这么说，手撑在他的胸口，不敢再使劲了。

    身子也是僵硬到了极点。

    李华放在她腰上的手，很热乎，像是个火炉，烫的她心慌难受。

    前天在红树林，李华也是这么靠近她。

    当时她只有害怕，但是现在除了害怕还有紧张、慌乱、很羞涩。

    前面。

    阿青下意识地回头，看到这一幕，嗖的一下把头又转了回去，嘴里面还在念叨着：“非礼勿视，非礼勿视。”

    然后左右看有没有人过来。

    他从小跟着李华一起玩，作为小弟的本分，几乎是刻在骨子里了。

    张春妮扭了扭腰，用近乎哀求的语气说道：“你松开我，好不好？”

    李华耍无赖，说道：“你以为我想搂着你啊。”

    “还不是你在恩将仇报。”

    “我好心扶住你，你却要把我推到海里去。”

    “我没办法才只能搂着你。”

    张春妮：“对……对不起，那我……我不推你了。”

    李华恋恋不舍的把手拿开，说道：“免得被你说耍流氓。”

    “接下来，我不拉着你。”

    “你抓着我的手臂。”

    张春妮犹豫不决。

    李华不耐烦的说道：“赶紧啊，潮水都涨上来了。”

    张春妮抬起手，搭在李华的手臂上。

    李华转身往上走。

    张春妮没抓稳，松开了。

    李华回头，把手臂伸过去，低声喝道：“抓紧啊。”

    张春妮：“哦哦。”

    结果往上走了几步，又松开了。

    李华不爽：“既然手抓不住，那不会搂着啊？”

    “你奶奶从小没有教你怎么搂？”

    “这还要我教你？”

    张春妮被凶得一愣一愣，大脑一片空白，一声不敢吭，只能老老实实的听话，把李华的手臂搂在怀里。

    经过刚才两次脱手的教训，也害怕再被李华凶，所以她搂得紧紧的。

    李华“嘶”了一口气。

    张春妮紧张不得了，小心翼翼的问道：“我……我是太用劲了？”

    “我……我松一点？”

    李华压住内心的澎湃：“没事，就这么搂着吧。”

    好女怕缠，烈女怕缠。

    他也不想这么凶张春妮，上这种手段，可他发现张春妮就爱吃这一套。

    他想着等在一起了，再好好的补偿吧。

    到时候一定把最美好、最温柔的一面，展现给张春妮。
content_en:
Li Hua's hand was still on Zhang Chunni's waist and he did not let go. He said, "If you push me again, I will fall into the sea."

    When Zhang Chuni heard what he said, she put her hands on his chest and didn't dare to exert any more force.

    His body was also extremely stiff.

    Li Hua's hand on her waist was very hot, like a stove, which made her feel flustered and uncomfortable.

    The day before yesterday in the mangrove forest, Li Hua was also so close to her.

    At that time, she was only afraid, but now besides fear, she is also nervous, flustered, and very shy.

    Front.

    Ah Qing turned around subconsciously. When he saw this scene, he turned his head back in a swish. He was still chanting: "See no evil, see no evil."

    Then look around to see if anyone is coming.

    He has played with Li Hua since he was a child, and his duty as a younger brother is almost engraved in his bones.

    Zhang Chuni twisted her waist and said in an almost pleading tone: "Please let go of me, okay?"

    Li Hua acted rogue and said, "You think I want to hug you."

    "It's not you who is repaying kindness with hatred."

    "I was kind enough to hold you up, but you wanted to push me into the sea."

    "I have no choice but to hold you."

    Zhang Chuni: "Yes...I'm sorry, then I...I won't push you anymore."

    Li Hua reluctantly took his hand away and said, "Lest I be accused of being a hooligan."

    "Next, I won't hold you back."

    "You hold my arm."

    Zhang Chunni hesitated.

    Li Hua said impatiently: "Hurry up, the tide is rising."

    Zhang Chuni raised her hand and put it on Li Hua's arm.

    Li Hua turned around and walked up.

    Zhang Chunni lost her grip and let go.

    Li Hua turned around, stretched out his arm, and shouted in a low voice: "Hold on."

    Zhang Chunni: "Oh."

    As a result, he took a few steps up and let go again.

    Li Hua was unhappy: "Since you can't hold it with your hands, why don't you hug me?"

    "Your grandma didn't teach you how to cuddle since you were a child?"

    "You want me to teach you this?"

    Zhang Chunni was stunned for a moment by the violence, her mind went blank, and she didn't dare to say a word. She could only obey and put Li Hua's arms in her arms.

    After the lesson she had learned twice before, she was also afraid of being hurt by Li Hua again, so she hugged him tightly.

    Li Hua hissed.

    Zhang Chunni was extremely nervous and asked cautiously: "I...am I trying too hard?"

    "I...should I relax a little?"

    Li Hua suppressed the turbulence in his heart: "It's okay, just hug her like this."

    A good girl is afraid of being pestered, and a brave girl is afraid of being pestered.

    He didn't want to be so cruel to Zhang Chuni and resort to such methods, but he found that Zhang Chuni liked this trick.

    He thought that they could make up for it after they were together.

    When the time comes, I will definitely show the most beautiful and gentle side to Zhang Chunni.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 16 I can’t bear it anymore
